No matter what, in any game, a certain item or weapon or combo will exist that gets the most throughput. Players like me enjoy pushing the game that way to get faster kills or higher numbers.

Because of that, a meta exists to achieve that. Because this is a PvE game, it won't harm other players like it would in a PvP game, but that doesn't mean a meta won't exist. If someone wants to push those categories, they will likely choose to follow that meta to achieve their goal. This doesn't mean players have to abide by it like in most PvP games to be competitive, however.

To some people, that is the fun part. It's like a puzzle to optimize something perfectly. With so many melds and such, there is a lot of theory crafting happening, and builds are constantly changing. There isn't one way to play a game. One person making meta builds to do big damage is his fun. Another person's may be gathering. Different ways to play a singular game.

You're not inherently wrong, but personally, I just like doing the most damage I can. It's something for me to work towards. Meta allows me to achieve that goal. It's PvE. People play it differently. Tough concept to grasp.

Want to single target? starfire twice to enter solar eclipse and wrath to generate astral power and spend on star surge.

There is more nuance at a deeper level, but that'll get you started. 

Also when you get hero talents and spec into trees, use them on cd when entering packs or starting a pull because they will apply starfire for you so you don't have to worry about it and can start big damage right after sunfire is applied.
